seo_title: Corporate Food Tours in KL & Penang | Simply Enak
seo_description: Book a corporate food tour for your team in Kuala Lumpur or Penang. Team building through authentic food experiences. Private groups, custom dates.
hero_subtitle: Your team, your pace, your private guide — from 2 to 20 people.
offer_body_1: Whether you're a multinational office looking for an evening activity, a remote team meeting for a retreat, or colleagues visiting KL for a conference — a private food tour is the most memorable way to experience Malaysia together. No icebreakers, no slides. Just great food and genuine connection.

offer_perfect_for.item: Work colleagues visiting KL or Penang at the same time
Corporate groups who want to eat where locals eat, not where tourists are sent
Teams wanting an active, engaging activity
International visitors wanting to understand Malaysian culture
Remote teams meeting up for retreats
